The 2026 Municipal and School Board Election will take place on Monday, October 26

NEW for 2026: Voting will take place online and by phone only. The County of Brant will offer in-person Voter Assistance Locations during advance voting and on Election Day to help residents who need assistance voting online.

For more information about the upcoming election, including voting dates, Voter Assistance Locations and registration information, visit www.brant.ca/voting 

The Election is almost here!

For more information about registration and how to vote, visit our Election Voting webpage

Grand River Street North Upgrades

- Oct 09, 2026
  • News and Public Notices
  • Road Construction

Major upgrades on Grand River Street North in Paris are kicking off soon, backed by over $9 million in provincial funding to save local taxpayers money. 

What's Happening and Where

  • Work begins on Ann Wilson Way before moving to the main stretch between Watts Pond Road and Silver Street (work will not begin on Grand River St N until this phase of the Downtown Dig is complete – which is expected in a couple of weeks!).
  • Two-way traffic stays open on Grand River Street North while crews work.
  • Area shops, restaurants and services remain completely open for business. 

Why Now?

  • Over $9 million in provincial grants covers the cost without heavy taxpayer burden.
  • The province requires project completion by the end of 2028.
  • Designed to support north Paris for the next 30 years, including a new public elementary school and fire hall. 

Key Improvements 

  • Widening to four lanes for smoother traffic.
  • Four modern roundabouts featuring safe pedestrian crossings.
  • A brand-new multi-use path, sidewalk, and upgraded streetlights. 

We will do our best to keep you informed. To subscribe for real-time construction updates, visit www.EngageBrant.ca/GrandRiverStreet
